svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.9.1 Decking
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Continuous lumber or panel-type roof sheathing is installed to support the roofing, except where the 1-in-50 hourly wind
pressure is less than 0.8 kPa (16.7 psf) and the seismic spectral acceleration, Sa(0.2), is less than or equal to 0.70.
Where Sentence 9.23.16.1.(1) requires continuous sheathing, the decking for a wood shingled roof is continuous.

svg.text: decking for wood shingled roofs may be
Drawn: 400 mm wood shingles at a 125 mm exposure on a slope of 1 in 2, shingles cut back. Decking board sizes and spacing are illustration only.
